newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cotton sales slow ahead of Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cotton sales slow ahead of Christmas.

text.p: Egypt exported only about 148 tonnes of cotton in the 14th week of this season due to the approach of Christmas and New Year holidays, the Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa) said on Monday.
"The exports are expected to remain very weak in the next week because of the holidays," an Alcotexa source told Reuters.
The association adjusted downwards to 61,440 its figure for total sales up to the end of the 14th week on December 19. Last week it said cumulative sales amounted to 65,379 tonnes.
"We excluded 12,000 bales (about 4,000 tonnes) last week," the source said. He declined to explain the reason for exclusion or the destination of the cotton.
The first three biggest buyers were unchanged from the previous week, with the United States the biggest at 16,069 tonnes, followed by Italy (13,352 tonnes) and then Switzerland (4,434 tonnes).
Alcotexa coordinates prices and exports by private and state-owned firms.

Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri said on Monday Egypt hoped to export 75,000 tonnes of cotton this season. Other sources have given high estimates -- between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes. --Esmat Salaheddin +20 2 578 3290/1
